needsOwnerDecision.reason: The ballot closes 23:59 BST on 14 Sep. From 15 Sep the open-ballot wording needs changing to 'closed, results from October' (reviewBy set to 2026-09-15).

General sale opens 17 Sep; the FAQ and plan need past tense after that (reviewBy 2026-09-18). The page also lists a 'Treasures' strand, and the BFI's 2026 strand list does not include one. St Martin-in-the-Fields is a new Expanded venue this year, not in the venue list.

Blue Note's own listing shows the Robert Glasper grand opening on Thu 24 Sep only. Both pages say it opens 23 Sep (Coltrane's centenary), and the venues guide says Glasper plays the 23rd and 24th. It could be a private opening night on the 23rd, so this was not changed. data/months/september-2026.json also says 23 Sep.

Southgate (early bird 'ends 1 September') and Enfield (early bird 'ends 31 August'). Eventbrite still advertises the Southgate early-bird prices, with a new sales window from 12 Sep and a low price that matches £8.50 plus fees, so it is unclear whether the prices changed. The Dugdale page shows no prices. Battersea's info page lists tier prices that look internally inconsistent (VIP £10.60 below GA £16.70), so they were not added.

The LGBTQ+ line says 'check back in September'; no Halloween programme was found for Heaven, G-A-Y or The Glory (G-A-Y's site returned 522, Heaven's did not load). Royal Institution Halloween Lecture has no 2026 date. elrow Horroween now shows 'from £40 + BF' against £41.95 on the page, which may be the same price with a different fee display.
Somerset House 'tickets on sale from September 2026' cannot be confirmed; the operator shows presale sign-up only. Recheck in late September along with the street-light switch-on dates.
